title: Order ahead for a pickup time
intent: Customers can order for a day and an hour, and the counter and the baker work from that pickup time. Last month the counter took 41 order-ahead requests by phone. Orders for now work as today.

WHY.label: Why customers ask for it
quote: Customers ask to order on Friday for a Saturday cake, and today they cannot.
The counter staff took 41 order-ahead requests by phone last month and wrote them on paper.

FORM.label: The order page today
quote: Order for pickup
Your name
Phone
What you would like
Ready as soon as it is baked. We text you when it is on the counter.
Place order

BOARD-TODAY.label: The board today
BOARD-TODAY.quote: Every order is for now: the board shows orders in the order they arrived.

PLAN-CHOICE.label: The pickup time choice
PLAN-CHOICE.quote: The order page gets a pickup time choice: as soon as possible, which is today's behaviour and stays the default, or a day and an hour.

PLAN-BOARD.label: The board by pickup time
quote: The counter's board lists orders by pickup time, not by when they arrived.
Orders for later days sit under a "Later" heading.

PLAN-BAKER.label: The baker's morning list
PLAN-BAKER.quote: The baker's morning list is the board for that day, grouped by hour.

PLAN-TEXT.label: The morning text
quote: The customer gets one text message on the morning of pickup.
The text we send today when an order is on the counter stays.

PLAN-KEPT.label: What stays
quote: Paying at pickup stays.
Orders for now work exactly as today.

Q-AHEAD.label: Question: how far ahead
quote: How far ahead may a customer order? We recommend up to two days.
A week would let customers plan parties, but the baker cannot plan flour that far.

Q-PAY.label: Question: when customers pay
quote: Should a customer pay when they order ahead, or at pickup? We recommend at pickup, as today.
Paying online needs a card service, which is a second project.

ORDER.label: The order of the work
ORDER.quote: (1) the pickup time on the order page; (2) the board by pickup time; (3) the baker's morning list; (4) the morning text.

COST.label: What it costs
COST.quote: The morning text uses the text service we already pay for, one more message per order ahead.

RISKS.label: Risks
quote: Too many orders for one hour on a Saturday. We would cap the orders per hour
If more than one in ten orders ahead are not picked up in the first month, we stop order ahead and talk to the owners.
The board's new order confuses the counter for a week. The counter staff see it before it goes live.
